notes: SR6 defers validity to the 2002 MOVE rules. §2002:14.8.24.2 SR5 bars only SPACE from a numeric receiver and §2002:8.3.1.2.5.2 SR3 bars ALL literal-1 from a numeric item only when literal-1 is longer than one character, so WRITE R1 (PIC 9(3)) FROM ALL "7" is valid; by §2002:14.8.47.3 GR3 it is MOVE ALL "7" TO R1 then WRITE R1, and §2002:8.3.1.2.5.3 GR2b repeats the character to the item's three positions: ALL-7=777. A numeric integer item CN of a CD record is a valid sender per Table 17 (§2002:14.8.24.2 SR8, Numeric integer to Numeric: Yes): CD-CN=456. Matched at --std 2002 with the pinned build of dc1f2dcce8 (g2_write_from_valid_move_sender).
